section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种用于生物基因工程的基因检测设备，包括壳体、检测单元、拿取单元、壳盖和防护板；壳体：所述壳盖与壳体的顶端相配合，壳体前侧面底端的通槽铰接有防护板，壳体内部的底端设有拿取单元，壳盖的底端设有拆卸单元；检测单元：包含第一直线电机、第二直线电机、电动伸缩杆、检测仪、检测探针，第二直线电机有两个且分别设在壳体内部的左右两侧，第一直线电机两端的定子分别与两个第二直线电机动子座的内侧面连接，第一直线电机动子座的底端设有电动伸缩杆，电动伸缩杆的底端安装有检测仪，检测仪的底端设有检测探针；该用于生物基因工程的基因检测设备，使用简单，拆卸方便，实用性强，检测效果好。

The utility model discloses a gene detection device for biological gene engineering, which comprises a shell, a detection unit, a taking unit, a shell cover and a protection plate; a housing: the shell cover is matched with the top end of the shell, a protection plate is hinged to a through groove at the bottom end of the front side face of the shell, a taking unit is arranged at the bottom end inside the shell, and a disassembling unit is arranged at the bottom end of the shell cover; a detection unit: the detection device comprises a first linear motor, a second linear motor, electric telescopic rods, a detector and detection probes, wherein the second linear motor is provided with two stators which are respectively arranged at the left side and the right side inside a shell; the gene detection equipment for the biological gene engineering is simple to use, convenient to disassemble, high in practicability and good in detection effect.

Gene detection equipment for biological gene engineeringTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a gene detection equipment technical field specifically is a gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineering.

Background

The gene is a basic unit of heredity, carries a DNA or RNA sequence of the heredity information, transfers the heredity information to the next generation through copying, guides the synthesis of protein to express the carried heredity information, thereby controlling the character expression of a biological individual, and the gene detection is a technology for detecting the DNA through blood, other body fluids or cells.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The to-be-solved technical problem of the utility model is to overcome current defect, provide a gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineering, simple to use, it is convenient to dismantle, and the practicality is strong, and detection effect is good, can effectively solve the problem in the background art.

In order to achieve the above object, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: a gene detection device for biological gene engineering comprises a shell, a detection unit, a taking unit, a shell cover and a protection plate;

a housing: the shell cover is matched with the top end of the shell, a protection plate is hinged to a through groove in the bottom end of the front side face of the shell, a taking unit is arranged at the bottom end inside the shell, and a disassembling unit is arranged at the bottom end of the shell cover;

a detection unit: the detection device comprises a first linear motor, a second linear motor, electric telescopic rods, a detector and detection probes, wherein the second linear motor is provided with two stators which are respectively arranged at the left side and the right side in the shell, the stators at the two ends of the first linear motor are respectively connected with the inner side surfaces of two second linear motor seats, the electric telescopic rods are arranged at the bottom end of the first linear motor seat, the detector is arranged at the bottom end of the electric telescopic rods, and the detection probes are arranged at the bottom end of the detector;

the electric telescopic rod type detection device is characterized by further comprising a controller, wherein the controller is arranged on the left side face of the shell, the input ends of the first linear motor, the second linear motor, the electric telescopic rod and the detector are electrically connected with the output end of the controller, and the input end of the controller is electrically connected with the output end of an external power supply.

Through the detection unit, the position of the detector can be adjusted according to the detection condition, so that the detection probe at the bottom end of the detector can accurately detect the material to be detected, and the detection effect is improved.

Further, the unit of taking contains the mounting groove, places board, T type piece, fixed block and electric putter, the fixed block is established in the inside bottom of casing, the T type groove and the T type piece sliding connection on fixed block top, the top of T type piece is equipped with places the board, the top of placing the board is equipped with the mounting groove, electric putter establishes at the inside trailing flank of casing, electric putter's front end is connected with the trailing flank of placing the board, the left and right sides of placing the board top all is equipped with fixed unit, electric putter's input electric connection controller's output can place waiting to detect the material, both make things convenient for subsequent detection, also makes things convenient for personnel to take simultaneously and place.

Further, fixed unit contains L template, pneumatic push rod, clamp plate and rubber pad, the L template is established in the one side of placing the board top, the bottom of L template horizontal direction is equipped with pneumatic push rod, pneumatic push rod's bottom is equipped with the clamp plate, the bottom of clamp plate is equipped with the rubber pad, pneumatic push rod's input electric connection director's output can be fixed waiting to detect the material to prevent that the final testing result of material malfunction influence in the testing process.

Further, it contains inserted block, elasticity bolt, slot and card hole to dismantle the unit, the inserted block has two and establishes respectively in the both sides of cap bottom, the slot has two and establishes respectively in the both sides on casing top, the slot is pegged graft mutually with the inserted block, the lateral surface of inserted block is equipped with the elasticity bolt, the lateral surface of slot is equipped with the card hole, the elasticity bolt cooperatees with the card hole, can conveniently dismantle the cap to be convenient for the later stage to maintain and maintain the device of casing inside.

Further, still include the display screen, the top at the casing leading flank is established to the display screen, the output of input electric connection controller of display screen can be with the data display that detects on the display screen to the personnel of being convenient for watch and record.

Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that: the gene detection equipment for biological gene engineering has the following advantages:

1. the position of the detector can be adjusted according to the detection condition through the detection unit, so that the detection probe at the bottom end of the detector can accurately detect the material to be detected, and the detection effect is improved;

2. the shell cover can be conveniently disassembled through the disassembling unit, so that the device in the shell can be conveniently maintained and maintained in the later period;

3. through fixed unit, can fix waiting to detect the material to prevent that material maloperation from influencing final testing result in the testing process, be equipped with the display screen, can show the data that detect on the display screen, thereby the personnel of being convenient for watch and record.

When in use: an external power supply is switched on, each electrical appliance works normally, firstly, a material to be detected is placed in the mounting groove 31 at the top end of the placing plate 32, the pneumatic push rod 42 is started to drive the pressing plate 43 to press downwards, the rubber pad 44 is arranged at the bottom end of the pressing plate 43, so that the material to be detected can be fixed, the influence of material misoperation on a final detection result in the detection process is prevented, then the electric push rod 35 is started to drive the T-shaped block 33 at the bottom end of the placing plate 32 to slide in the T-shaped groove at the top end of the fixing block 34, the placing plate 32 is moved into the shell 1, then the first linear motor 21, the second linear motor 22 and the electric telescopic rod 23 are started simultaneously to move the detector 24 to a proper position, so that the detection probe 25 at the bottom end of the detector 24 can accurately detect the material to be detected, the detection effect is improved, the detected data are, when the device inside the casing 1 breaks down, the elastic bolt 52 is pressed to make the insert block 51 leave the slot 53, so that the casing cover 6 is convenient to disassemble, and the device inside the casing 1 is convenient to repair and maintain at a later stage.
